Thanks for the PR.

> As a result, awaiting either method can finish before the frame has been processed or its transcript callback has run.

This is intended behaviour. See https://picovoice.ai/docs/api/cheetah-web/ for more information. Since this feature is not currently on our roadmap, if you are a Picovoice Enterprise customer, please reach out to your Picovoice sales contact to request this feature.
